exposure: Delivery outcomes (stillbirths, maternal and neonatal deaths)
cohort: Pregnant women and newborns in Liberia, West Africa
finding: The Ebola outbreak in Liberia led to a significant decline in access to maternal health services, including antenatal care, deliveries, and skilled birth attendance, but these measures returned to pre-outbreak levels within one year.
mod_finding: Reported deliveries by Caesarian section declined by 60% during the outbreak.
